name: Eyes on the Sky
summary: A note warns that the Razormane are carrying out an unseen ritual in Thousand Needles. You are asked to seek an answer to the threat of storms and rising tides.

sections.title: A Gathering Threat
sections.body: The note you found points to the Razormane in Thousand Needles, where an unseen ritual is underway. Raging storms and rising tides raise the fear that the canyon may be flooded. The quilboar may be drawing on elemental power learned from Hirzek, a shaman. Return to your allies and speak with Prate Cloudseer.

faq.answer: It says the Razormane have burrowed into Thousand Needles for an unseen ritual, amid raging storms and rising tides.
Hirzek is a shaman who taught the quilboar sorcery that twists the elements.

faq.q: What threat do the quilboar pose?
faq.answer: The feared danger is that the quilboar could use elemental power to flood the canyon.
You are asked to speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

attribution: In-game quest text: Eyes on the Sky
